newsitem.title: USA: Arkansas Best sees continued carrier loss.
newsitem.headline: Arkansas Best sees continued carrier loss.

text.p: Arkansas Best said its western regional carrier, G.I. Trucking, will likely continue to lose money for at least another quarter as it rebuilds revenues lost when Carolina Freight Co and Arkansas Best unit ABF Freight Systems combined last year.
It said though G.I. Trucking again lost money in the third quarter, it continued to rebuild its revenue base and third quarter revenues were about 11 percent ahead of the second quarter.
G.I.'s operating ratio was 107.3 percent for the third quarter.
